text:
Priya: Heads-up — candidate for SRE backend moved up to 3pm PT (was 4pm). Need panel coverage + a scribe for debrief. Also quick rubric clarification request from hiring.
Elena: I can cover the panel but have a short deploy window 3:10–3:25. I might join a minute late, ok?
Priya: @Elena that's fine — start without us, we'll keep Q1 short.
Samir: I can scribe and own the debrief doc + normalization. Will capture score anchors.
Priya: Thanks Samir. Hiring asked to adjust weights for this role: tech 60, design 25, collaboration 15 (previously collab 10). Confirming we should use those for scoring.
Aisha: Quick question — are we using the live-only rubric or the take-home+live combined one for this loop?
Priya: Live-only for this candidate. Use the "live-sre-compact" rubric (link: https://redwood.in/ops/rubrics/live-sre-compact). Note collaboration anchor updated to: "Cross-team communication & calm under incident pressure." 
Maya: @Samir I'll be co-panelist. Happy to paste transcript snippets into the doc. Do you want a section for quotes vs observations?
Samir: Yes please — two sections: `quotes` and `observations`. I'll normalize scores after the call.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Panel 3:00 PM PT, scribe Samir, co-panelist Maya. Calendar updated and candidate email sent.
Priya: One last ops note: if you adjust a score by >1 point from your initial gut feeling, add a 1–2 line justification in the doc. :thumbsup:
Elena: Got it, joining ~3:07. If my deploy runs long, @Maya can you call out any infra-specific questions?
Maya: Yep, I'll cover infra questions. Good luck team.
Priya: Thanks everyone — will post the debrief doc link in DM to Samir now.
